title: Redis in Production
subtitle: Monitoring, security, and operational best practices

content.text: Redis has no authentication by default. In production, enable requirepass, bind to localhost, and use TLS.
Use INFO ALL to see metrics and monitor slowlog for slow commands.

content.code:
redis-cli INFO memory
redis-cli INFO stats
redis-cli SLOWLOG GET 10
redis-cli MONITOR   # real-time command log (dev only)

content.text: Never run MONITOR in production — it logs every command and significantly impacts performance.

questions.question: What command shows the slowest recent Redis commands?
questions.explanation: SLOWLOG GET returns the most recent commands that exceeded the slowlog threshold.

faq.q: What is a good maxmemory setting?
faq.a: Set maxmemory to 70-80% of available RAM to leave headroom for fork() during RDB saves and OS buffers.
